intro: From the history section of the Urdu Wikipedia article on Lahore: the Mughal emperors and the buildings and gardens they left in the city. Notice the causative verb “taameer karwaana” (to have something built), which comes up again and again.

sentences.urdu: ظہیر الدین بابر نے 1526ء میں ابراہیم لودھی کو شکست دی جس کے نتیجے میں مغلیہ سلطنت وجود میں آئی۔
sentences.english: In 1526 Zaheer-ud-Din Babur defeated Ibrahim Lodhi, as a result of which the Mughal Empire came into being.

sentences.urdu: مغلوں نے اپنے دور میں لاہور میں عظیم الشان عمارات تعمیر کروائیں اور کئی باغات لگوائے۔
sentences.english: During their rule the Mughals had magnificent buildings built in Lahore and had many gardens laid out.

sentences.urdu: اکبر اعظم نے شاہی قلعہ کو ازسرنو تعمیر کروایا۔
sentences.english: Akbar the Great had the Royal Fort rebuilt.

sentences.urdu: شاہجہان نے شالامار باغ تعمیر کروایا جو اپنی مثال آپ ہے۔
sentences.english: Shah Jahan had the Shalimar Garden built, which is one of a kind.

sentences.urdu: 1646ء میں شہزادی جہاں آرا نے دریائے راوی کے کنارے چوبرجی باغ تعمیر کروایا جس کا بیرونی دروازہ آج بھی موجود ہے۔
sentences.english: In 1646 Princess Jahanara had the Chauburji garden built on the bank of the River Ravi; its outer gateway still stands today.

sentences.urdu: 1673ء میں اورنگزیب عالمگیر نے شاہی قلعہ کے سامنے بادشاہی مسجد تعمیر کروائی۔
sentences.english: In 1673 Aurangzeb Alamgir had the Badshahi Mosque built opposite the Royal Fort.

ظہیر: Zaheer (part of the name Zaheer-ud-Din Babur)
الدین: “of the faith” (part of the name Zaheer-ud-Din)
لودھی: Lodhi (Ibrahim Lodhi, the last Lodi sultan of Delhi)
جس: which (oblique) (“jis ke natije mein” = as a result of which)
نتیجے: result (oblique) (“ke natije mein” = as a result of)
وجود: existence (“wujood mein aana” = to come into being)
کروائیں: had (them) made (f. pl.) (“taameer karwaaeen” = had built)
اعظم: the Great (“akbar aazam” = Akbar the Great)
شاہی: royal (“shaahi qila” = the Royal Fort, i.e. Lahore Fort)
مثال: example; match (“apni misaal aap hona” = to be one of a kind)
آپ: itself (“apni misaal aap” = its own example, i.e. unmatched)
جہاں: Jahan (part of the name Jahan Ara)
دریائے: river of (izafat: “darya-e raavi” = the River Ravi)
کنارے: bank; edge (oblique) (“ke kinaare” = on the bank of)

questions.urdu: مغلیہ سلطنت کس واقعے کے نتیجے میں وجود میں آئی؟
questions.english: What event led to the Mughal Empire coming into being?

options.english: The building of the Badshahi Mosque
The building of the Shalimar Garden
